messages:
nina: quick thought 1: should gateway signal the edge when a response becomes client-visible so the edge stops speculative hedging? we had duplicate payments when hedging replayed after client got a success chunk.
kai: yes. we need a clear contract: gateway tells edge 'client saw progress', edge demotes hedging for that request id.
omar: concrete: header `x-rw-client-visible: 1` once gateway observes client ACK or after first chunk for http/1. edge runtime treats it as hedging_window=0 but still allows safe retries for idempotent ops.
lena: and for resume semantics: runtime can emit trailer `x-rw-resume-token: v1:<enc>` at stream end. gateway persists token id and offers resume if client reconnects. if no token, treat as partial/no-resume.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: gateway patch queued for canary (owner: @kai). :rocket:
nina: billing/product question: do we charge full request when client-visible set and client disconnects? product wants deterministic behavior across hosted and dedicated.
kai: proposal: bill to last persisted checkpoint/trailer. if resume-token present -> bill until that checkpoint. else bill to last chunk send time. keeps it deterministic.
omar: runtime change: on `x-rw-client-visible`, runtime must persist any resume token and mark a trace tag `client_visible=true`. add metrics `edge.client_visible.received`, `edge.client_visible.hedges_suppressed`, `edge.resume.tokens_persisted`.
lena: security: resume tokens must be encrypted, single-use, TTL, and customer-scoped. gateway should only receive an opaque id (not raw token) unless customer opts in. store blobs in KVS with TTL and audit.
nina: rollout: gateway emits header only when it talks to edge runtimes >= 1.10 or when feature-flag enabled per customer. older edges ignore header and continue current hedging behavior.
kai: ops: add admin endpoints to list/revoke persisted resume tokens (admin-only, redact values). and telemetry to detect suppressed retries that would've succeeded to catch false positives.
lena: i'll draft the RFC with header/trailer names, telemetry table, KVS schema (opaque id mapping), and canary checklist. can i get quick +1?
kai: +1
omar: +1
nina: thanks all, i'll post RFC link when done. :thumbsup:
